It was established by Bishop [[Donald Wuerl]] in 1989 as the merger of former all-girl parish high schools of Sacred Heart and St. Paul Cathedral to serve as a [[sister school]] for [[Central Catholic High School (Pittsburgh)|Central Catholic]]. Approximately 600 students matriculate at Oakland Catholic and the school draws female students from all over Pittsburgh and its suburbs. Upon graduation, 100% of its students continue to a four-year university.{{citation needed|date=September 2023}} Oakland Catholic High School completed construction and renovations for the 2008-2009 school year. ==Athletics== Oakland Catholic offers 18 different sports stretching over three seasons (fall, winter and spring.) Fall sports *Cross country *Field hockey *Golf *Soccer *Tennis *Volleyball Winter sports *Basketball *Sideline Cheer *Fencing *Indoor track *Swimming and diving Spring sports *Lacrosse *Softball *Track and field *Ultimate Highlights *Basketball - Oakland Catholic is known for its girls basketball team. From 1998–2008 they were involved in every district championship ([[Western Pennsylvania Interscholastic Athletic League|W.P.I.A.L.]]) game. They also won several Pennsylvania State Championship titles. The current{{as of?|date=September 2023}} women's head basketball coach is OC alumna, Brianne O'Rourke, OCHS'05 and former director of the woman's basketball operations at the University of Pittsburgh. *Swimming - Oakland Catholic swimming also has a number of state championships.{{cite web|url=http://www.pittsburghlive.com/x/pittsburghtrib/sports/highschool/s_497965.html|title=Oakland Catholic wins PIAA Class AA team swimming title|access-date=2010-12-06|author=Keith Barnes, TRIBUNE-REVIEW}}{{cite web|url=http://dailyitem.com/0200_sports/x434656238/High-School-Swimming-Oakland-Catholic-girls-win-state-title|title=High School Swimming: Oakland Catholic girls win state title|access-date=2010-12-06|author=Todd Hummel}} Oakland Catholic Swimming is widely known throughout the region for its multiple W.P.I.A.L. and state ([[Pennsylvania Interscholastic Athletic Association|P.I.A.A.]]) titles. *Soccer - Oakland Catholic girls soccer won the WPIAL Class 3A Championship in 2018. The Eagles also advanced to the PIAA State semi-finals finishing with an overall record of 20-2, which is the best soccer season in OCHS history to date.{{as of?|date=September 2023}} ==Academic departments== *English *Fine arts *Foreign languages *Health and physical education *Math *Religion *Science *Social studies == Notable alumni == * [[Leah Smith (swimmer)|Leah Smith]] * [[Amanda Polk]] * Gianna Martello, choreographer for the [[Abby Lee Dance Company]] from [[Dance Moms]] ==Notes and references== {{reflist|2}} ==External links== * {{official website|oaklandcatholic.org/}} {{Roman Catholic Diocese of Pittsburgh|state=collapsed}} {{Girls' schools in Pennsylvania}} {{PittsburghCatholicSchools}} {{authority control}} [[Category:Girls' schools in Pennsylvania]] [[Category:Catholic secondary schools in Pennsylvania]] [[Category:High schools in Pittsburgh]] [[Category:Educational institutions established in 1989]] [[Category:1989 establishments in Pennsylvania]]
